description:
Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Burning Anger by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Steelfin Whale trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target
Repeat steps 4 and 5 once, then repeat step 4 an additional time.
Repeat from step 1.
